lead: `function (…) { … }` is `E0222` outright; `fn (…) => …` or `fn (…) => { … }` is the one closure literal.
body: Calling it through its variable or `$f(...$args)` lowers, but a call through a `callable` answers `mixed`, so the result takes an `as T` where a narrower type is declared (`rule:types/closure-literal`). When a sweep's rows are *data*, a typed array plus `foreach`, counting into an `int` declared above the loop, is the shape.
